name: citesync
description: citesync generates and synchronizes software citation metadata across CITATION.cff, CodeMeta, Zenodo and package files using CodeMeta crosswalks. Use the CLI or pre-commit hook to keep repository metadata consistent, or generate citation files in the browser playground. Imports include Python, Rust, npm, R and Julia package metadata; the CLI and playground also export BibTeX, CSL-JSON, APA and JSON-LD citations.
